title: Spaceship Always False
content:
Compare A to B, and A is bigger than B.
Compare B to A, and B is bigger than A.
And, in the end, they are still different.
author: Jerome Tamarelle
code:
<?php

class A {}
class B {}

$a = new A;
$b = new B;

var_dump($a <=> $b); // 1: A > B
var_dump($b <=> $a); // 1: B > A 
var_dump($b == $a);  // false
